purpose: Resource-bounded repetition of the frozen real transport hard-negative pilot. It is a prompt/protocol stress test, not a biomedical validation or model-ranking study.

resource_safety.execution_mode: one local model request at a time, with keep_alive=0 after every response

analysis_unit: generation nested within packet-model-condition; all 15 packets remain one dependent source panel and are not independent biomedical samples
excluded_data_rule: Partial or completed runs of excluded models remain raw execution records only and must be excluded before scoring, aggregation, or interpretation.
prohibited_interpretations: inferential statistics that treat gene/program packets as independent samples
